newsitem.title: SPAIN: Warburg still sees Telefonica attractive.
newsitem.headline: Warburg still sees Telefonica attractive.

text.p: Third-quarter results at Spain's Telefonica met forecasts, but strong growth in the core business continues to make the stock attractive, brokerage SBC Warburg said in a research note dated November 11.
"Telefonica remains one of the best strategically positioned operators in Europe," Warburg said in a note reiterating a buy recommendation on the stock.
"Volume growth in the domestic wireline business...(is) stronger than anticipated and appears to confirm that Telefonica's advertising and marketing is paying off," it added.

Warburg also underscored "good news" that the Spanish telecoms market will be liberalised in 1998, as this meant "(Telefonica) still gets nearly 12 months longer than most of Europe, its domestic position remains strong and Unisource can go ahead as planned."
Last week, Telefonica posted a 19.8 percent increase in nine-month earnings to 120 billion pesetas.
